hermes_item_pipe.description: Basic tier. Transfers items between compatible inventories.

naiad_fluid_pipe.description: Basic tier. Transfers fluids between compatible tanks and machines.

advanced_hermes_item_pipe.description: Advanced tier. Transfers items between compatible inventories.

advanced_naiad_fluid_pipe.description: Advanced tier. Transfers fluids between compatible tanks and machines.

supreme_hermes_item_pipe.description: Supreme tier. Transfers items between compatible inventories.

supreme_naiad_fluid_pipe.description: Supreme tier. Transfers fluids between compatible tanks and machines.

volcanite_energy_wire.description: Basic energy wire for connecting generators, storage and powered machines.

advanced_volcanite_energy_wire.description: Advanced energy wire for connecting generators, storage and powered machines.

supreme_volcanite_energy_wire.description: Supreme energy wire for connecting generators, storage and powered machines.

singularity_volcanite_energy_wire.description: Singularity energy wire for connecting generators, storage and powered machines.

volcanite_storage_pipe.description: Connects Obsidium storage-network infrastructure; distinct from dedicated Hermes item pipes.

volcanite_universal_conduit.description: Universal conduit (conducta universala), named Magmatic Flux Conduit in-game. Transports items, fluids and RF with per-face Item / Fluid / Energy / Omni channels. Use a wrench to cycle a face mode, or sneak with the wrench to cycle its channel type. Its configuration GUI accepts compatible transfer upgrades.
